create_epsilon_greedy_exploration: create an EGreedyExploration instance with a fixed epsilon value for exploration
create_epsilon_greedy_with_scheduling: create an EGreedyExploration instance with start epsilon, end epsilon, and warmup steps for scheduling
act_epsilon_greedy: call act on EGreedyExploration to select an action using epsilon-greedy strategy with a discrete action space
get_extra_state_egreedy: call get_extra_state on EGreedyExploration to serialize current epsilon scheduling state to a dictionary
compare_egreedy_exploration: call compare on EGreedyExploration to find differences between two exploration module instances
